title: Application Launcher has different minimal sizes depending if the Panel is horizontal or vertical
line: Widget popups such as the Application Launcher keep the same size when the panel moves between horizontal and vertical screen edges.
explanation: CompactApplet reserves one extra pixel for the separator line between a panel and its widget popups, but added it only to the popup's height on horizontal panels and only to its width on vertical ones. The popup's minimum size and the size saved in popupWidth/popupHeight therefore changed by one pixel whenever the panel moved to another edge, and since the saved size never shrinks, the popup grew a pixel wider or taller (which can cost Kickoff a grid column). The change reserves that pixel in both directions on every panel edge, so the minimum and saved size no longer depend on the panel's edge.

commits.message:
desktoppackage/applet: keep popup size the same on every panel edge

The pixel kept for the separator line went to the height on horizontal
panels and to the width on vertical ones, so moving the panel changed
the popup's minimum and saved size. Now it is added in both directions.

BUG: 512298

media.caption: Before: Kickoff shrunk to its minimum is 647x509 with the panel at the bottom (left) but 648x508 with the panel on the left (right); moving the panel left permanently changed the saved width 647 to 648
After: Kickoff's minimum is 648x509 on both edges, and the saved size stays the same through repeated bottom/left moves

review.text: Simple, consistent fix in CompactApplet.qml for the 1 px minimum/saved-size drift when moving panels between horizontal and vertical edges. Reserving the 1 px separator allowance in both extraWidth and extraHeight across all four panel-edge states follows the same symmetry strategy already established by commit e1ea430172 (bug 512273) for floating vs non-floating panels, preventing popup size growth or Kickoff column loss across edge moves. Verification confirms identical minimum and persisted popup sizes across repeated horizontal/vertical moves on both floating and non-floating panels.

reviews.text: Simple, consistent fix in CompactApplet.qml for the 1 px minimum/saved-size drift when moving panels between horizontal and vertical edges. Reserving the 1 px separator allowance in both extraWidth and extraHeight across all four panel-edge states follows the same symmetry strategy already established by commit e1ea430172 (bug 512273) for floating vs non-floating panels, preventing popup size growth or Kickoff column loss across edge moves. Verification confirms identical minimum and persisted popup sizes across repeated horizontal/vertical moves on both floating and non-floating panels.

This finds the actual one-pixel source the reporter asked about in comment 3: CompactApplet reserved the separator pixel only along the separator's axis, so the popup minimum and the persisted popupWidth/popupHeight depended on the panel edge, and the content could briefly drop below Kickoff's minimum and lose a column (Nate, comment 6). Reserving the pixel on both axes gives the same minimum and saved size on every edge, and the content always gets at least its minimum. It is a pragmatic one-pixel pad rather than storing the size without the separator, but it is tiny, keeps the structure from e1ea430172, and touches nothing outside panel popups. The measured sizes in verify (647x509 vs 648x508 before, 648x509 on both edges and stable across round trips after) support it, though a one-pixel difference can't be seen in the screenshots themselves; the commit message matches the diff.
